name: agentic-data-access-benchmark
description:
Agentic Data Access Benchmark (ADAB)
	

Agentic Data Access Benchmark is a set of real-world questions over few "closed domains" to illustrate the evaluation of closed domain AI assistants/agents.
Closed domains are domains where data is not available implicitly in the LLM as they reside in secure or private systems e.g. enterprise databases, SaaS applications, etc
and AI solutions require mechanisms to connect an LLM to such data. If you are evaluating an AI product or building your… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hasura/agentic-data-access-benchmark.
reputation: Emerging benchmark on Hugging Face used by researchers evaluating agent-to-data connectors for closed/private domains; modest adoption so far.
